import asyncio


async def lazy_nested_outer_decl(assignments, clients):
    blocking = None
    for a in assignments:
        blocking = None
        for c in clients:
            if blocking is None:
                # want: await-in-loop-python
                blocking = await active_change(c)
        use(a, blocking)


async def guard_condition(items):
    for item in items:
        # want: await-in-loop-python
        if await is_blocked(item.id):
            continue
        process(item)


async def compound_assign(items):
    total = 0
    for item in items:
        # want: await-in-loop-python
        total += await count(item.id)
    return total


async def append_dict(items):
    out = []
    for item in items:
        # want: await-in-loop-python
        out.append({"id": item.id, "name": await name(item.id)})
    return out


async def nested_header_await(groups):
    for group in groups:
        # want: await-in-loop-python
        for member in await list_members(group.id):
            sync(member)


async def rollback_inner_loop(items):
    created = []
    for item in items:
        if not check(item):
            for done in created:
                # want: await-in-loop-python
                await remove(done)
            raise ValueError("failed")
        created.append(item.id)


async def enumerate_loop(items):
    for i, item in enumerate(items):
        # want: await-in-loop-python
        await save(i, item)


async def per_item_reverse(items):
    for i in reversed(range(len(items))):
        # want: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(save(items[i]), audit(items[i]))


async def per_item_minus_one(items):
    for i in range(len(items) - 1, -1, -1):
        # want: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(save(items[i]), audit(items[i]))


async def async_with_in_loop(items, lock):
    for item in items:
        async with lock:
            # want: await-in-loop-python
            await save(item)


async def try_finally(items):
    for item in items:
        try:
            use(item)
        finally:
            # want: await-in-loop-python
            await release(item)


async def ternary(items):
    for item in items:
        # want: await-in-loop-python
        v = item.value if item.cached else await load(item.id)
        use(v)


async def while_queue(queue):
    while queue:
        item = queue.pop()
        # want: await-in-loop-python
        await process(item)


async def comp_four_clauses(a, b, c, d):
    # want: await-in-loop-python
    return [await f(w, x, y, z) for w in a for x in b for y in c for z in d]


async def comp_filter_two(items, groups):
    # want: await-in-loop-python
    return [await f(x) for g in groups if g for x in g if x]


async def gen_expr(items):
    # want: await-in-loop-python
    return sum([await f(x) for x in items])


async def dict_filter(keys):
    # want: await-in-loop-python
    return {k: await f(k) for k in keys if k}


async def lazy_keyed(items, cache):
    for item in items:
        if item.id not in cache:
            # want: await-in-loop-python
            cache[item.id] = await load(item.id)


async def lazy_local_or(items):
    for item in items:
        row = cache.get(item.id)
        # want: await-in-loop-python
        row = row or await load(item.id)
        use(row)


async def chunk_of_one(items):
    for batch in chunks(items, 1):
        # want: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*(save(x) for x in batch))
